Lady '''Arilyn Dhulaine''' is a noble from [[Cairhien]].

== History ==
Lady Arilyn is slightly above the middle rank of nobility and thus she can worn stripes nearly to the her waist. Her sigil is a pair of silver stars above green and red stripes.

She is an informant of the [[Gray Ajah]], and likely has been for some time.

While [[Niande]] Sedai was advisor to King [[Galldrian]] of Cairhien she was known to have visited the country estate of Lady Arilyn more than once.

== Activities ==
The embassy from the [[White Tower]] led by [[Coiren Saeldain]], took place at Lady Arilyn's palace in Cairhien.{{ref/book|6|25}} After Coiren Sedai took over Dhulaine Mansion in the city, Lady Arilyn reportedly went to join her husband on a country estate.

[[Rand]] and [[Min]] were held in Arilyn palace for a while after their kidnapping by Elaida's Aes Sedai.

[[Cadsuane]] and her entourage later took Arilyn's palace as well. Here was where Cadsuane kept High Lord [[Darlin]] and Lady [[Caraline]] as "guest" until [[Dobraine]] freed them on Rand's orders.
